chunks: "Dyeing with black is comfort for women and a source of awe for the enemy."
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about dyeing with black?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teaches that dyeing with black has social and relational benefits. It brings comfort and pleasing companionship to women, while also projecting dignity and awe before enemies.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.281 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Dyeing (the hair or beard) with black brings comfort to women and inspires awe in enemies."
